title: Sunny and the Sleepy Echidna
author: Jamie Wigg
the_end_text:
The End.
Sweet dreams, little one. Goodnight.
back_cover_blurb: When Sunny the little quokka wanders out into the soft blue evening, she meets a gentle, sleepy echidna snuffling quietly in the leaves. Together they share the calm, cosy ways of the bush at night — soft spines, quiet snuffles, and a moon that watches over them all. A calm, cosy bedtime tale for winding down and drifting off to sleep. Perfect for little ones ages 1-5.

pages.scene: Sunny the little quokka stands at the edge of a soft blue evening bush, tall gum trees around her, warm honey-gold light glowing low behind the deep plum-navy hills, a few early stars just waking.
pages.text: The evening was soft and blue, and Sunny the little quokka went out for a gentle wander. The bush was hushed and cosy all around her.

pages.scene: Sunny padding slowly along a moonlit path through soft leaf litter, tiny fireflies drifting like sleepy lanterns, gum trees glowing plum-navy against a honey-gold sky.
pages.text: Slowly, softly, Sunny padded along the leafy path. Little fireflies floated by like tiny sleepy lanterns.

pages.scene: Sunny pausing with one paw lifted, ears turned, listening beside a fallen log in the warm moonlight, leaf litter soft beneath her, stars twinkling above.
pages.text: Then Sunny stopped and listened. Somewhere in the leaves came a gentle little sound.

pages.scene: A soft rustle in the golden leaf litter near Sunny's paws, a tiny snout just peeking out, fireflies glowing warmly, deep plum-navy shadows all cosy and calm.
pages.text: Snuffle, snuffle, went the sound, soft as a whisper. The leaves wiggled just a little bit.

pages.scene: A round little echidna with cream-and-brown soft spines emerging from the leaf litter, its small pointed snout snuffling, Sunny watching gently and kindly in the honey-gold moonlight.
pages.text: Out came a little round echidna, soft and sleepy. “Hello,” whispered Sunny. “I didn’t mean to wake you.”

pages.scene: The echidna smiling softly at Sunny, its cream-and-brown spines gentle and cosy, the two of them nose to nose in warm moonlight, fireflies drifting, gum trees glowing plum-navy.
pages.text: “That’s alright,” said the echidna kindly. “I was only snuffling for my supper before bed.”

pages.scene: The echidna dipping its little pointed snout softly into the leaf litter beside Sunny, snuffling quietly for tiny ants, warm honey-gold light and soft plum shadows all around.
pages.text: “I snuffle very softly with my little snout,” the echidna said. “Just quiet, gentle sniffs in the cosy leaves.”

pages.scene: Close, tender view of the echidna's cream-and-brown spines, soft and rounded in the moonlight, Sunny reaching a gentle paw near them, fireflies glowing warmly.
pages.text: “And see my spines?” said the echidna. “They look pointy, but they feel soft and gentle, nothing to fear.”

pages.scene: Sunny softly touching the echidna's spines with a tiny paw, both of them smiling, cosy and safe in the warm honey-gold moonlight, deep plum-navy bush hushed around them.
pages.text: Sunny gave the spines a soft little pat. They were warm and gentle, just like a cosy blanket.

pages.scene: The echidna slowly beginning to tuck its snout in and curl its soft round body, Sunny watching cosily, gum trees and stars glowing gently in the plum-navy night.
pages.text: “When I am sleepy,” the echidna yawned, “I curl up into a cosy little ball, all soft and round.”

pages.scene: Sunny and the echidna sitting side by side on soft leaf litter, both looking up at a big round golden moon rising over the plum-navy gum trees, fireflies drifting.
pages.text: Together they looked up at the big round moon. It glowed soft and golden, like a warm little nightlight.

pages.scene: Sunny and the echidna gazing up at a sky full of gentle twinkling stars, honey-gold and deep plum-navy, the bush calm and quiet, fireflies floating slowly.
pages.text: The stars came out one by one, twinkling softly above. “Goodnight, little stars,” Sunny whispered.

pages.scene: Sunny giving a big cosy yawn, eyes half closed, the sleepy echidna beside her yawning too, warm moonlight glowing, soft leaf litter beneath them.
pages.text: A big sleepy yawn floated up from Sunny. The echidna yawned too, soft and slow.

pages.scene: The echidna slowly curling into a soft round ball among the golden leaves, snug and cosy, Sunny watching with tender sleepy eyes in the honey-gold moonlight.
pages.text: Slowly, softly, the echidna curled into a cosy round ball. “Goodnight, Sunny,” it murmured, warm and snug.

pages.scene: Sunny leaning down gently over the sleeping curled echidna, tucking a soft leaf near it like a little blanket, fireflies glowing, plum-navy bush peaceful and still.
pages.text: “Sweet dreams, little echidna,” Sunny whispered softly. She tucked a gentle leaf close, like a tiny blanket.

pages.scene: Sunny padding slowly home through soft silver-gold moonlit grass, gum trees glowing plum-navy, the sleeping echidna a small cosy shape in the leaves behind her, stars above.
pages.text: Then Sunny padded home through the moonlit grass, soft and slow. The whole bush felt warm and calm and safe.

pages.scene: Sunny walking sleepily along the gentle path, fireflies drifting beside her like tiny stars, the honey-gold moon glowing overhead in the hushed plum-navy night.
pages.text: The fireflies drifted along beside her, glowing soft and low. Everything was quiet and sleepy now.

pages.scene: Sunny arriving at her cosy little nest tucked among warm mossy roots and soft leaves, the moon glowing gently through the gum trees, plum-navy shadows soft all around.
pages.text: At last Sunny reached her own cosy little nest, all soft and warm. She snuggled down into the gentle leaves.

pages.scene: Sunny curled up snug in her cosy nest with eyes closing, a soft smile, warm honey-gold moonlight glowing over her, stars twinkling gently through the leaves above.
pages.text: Sunny curled up small and warm, her eyes growing heavy. “Goodnight, everyone,” she breathed softly.

pages.scene: Sunny fast asleep in her cosy nest, a tiny dreamy echidna curled among soft glowing stars above her head, the whole scene warm honey-gold and deep plum-navy, calm and peaceful.
pages.text: And as she drifted off to sleep, Sunny dreamed of a soft, round, sleepy echidna. Goodnight, little Sunny, goodnight.
